toolkit.label: Party WF · twists
toolkit.title: Windfury Totem uptime PROVIDED TO HIS PARTY (165 drops, 8 twists/min; totem buffs aren't logged as auras in 2.5, so modeled from cast cadence). Twisting is OPTIMAL — the WF buff persists when swapped, so a twister keeps WF AND Grace of Air up. The shaman never benefits himself (WF weapon enchant suppresses it). · Grace of Air ~88% up · 289 WF↔GoA swaps (actively twisting both) · 2 Bloodlust
